primaryChecks.text: at Bethuel, at Hormah, at Ziklag,
primaryChecks.previousContext: at Bilhah, at Ezem, at Tolad,
primaryChecks.nextContext: at Beth Marcaboth, Hazar Susim, at Beth Biri, and at Shaaraim. These were their cities until David’s reign.
primaryChecks.decisionJa: 初出節の地理用法を確認。常時表示の要約はこの節で確認できる内容に限定した。

primaryChecks.text: Now these are those who came to David to Ziklag while he was a fugitive from Saul the son of Kish. They were among the mighty men, his helpers in war.
primaryChecks.nextContext: They were armed with bows, and could use both the right hand and the left in slinging stones and in shooting arrows from the bow. They were of Saul’s relatives of the tribe of Benjamin.
primaryChecks.decisionJa: 後続節の用例として確認し、この内容は当該節をknownByとする事実へ分離した。

primaryChecks.text: As he went to Ziklag, some from Manasseh joined him: Adnah, Jozabad, Jediael, Michael, Jozabad, Elihu, and Zillethai, captains of thousands who were of Manasseh.
primaryChecks.previousContext: Some of Manasseh also joined David when he came with the Philistines against Saul to battle, but they didn’t help them, for the lords of the Philistines sent him away after consultation, saying, “He will desert to his master Saul to the jeopardy of our heads.”
primaryChecks.nextContext: They helped David against the band of raiders, for they were all mighty men of valor and were captains in the army.
primaryChecks.decisionJa: 後続節の用例として確認し、この内容は当該節をknownByとする事実へ分離した。
